title: Exact Copy App Ad
tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

exact_text.text: Plan your day in one place.
exact_text.read_as: Plan your day in one place.

faults.what: At 5.6 seconds, large green checkmarks overlap the second scene's text panel, cluttering an otherwise legible layout.

The supplied audio report includes unintended speech, "Sustantivo femenino." The reported peak of -91 dB suggests effectively inaudible audio, but removing the audio track would ensure the requested silence.

judge.summary: The ad has all three exact lines and the requested cream-and-green graphics, with minor text-panel overlap and reported near-silent unwanted audio.

must_haves.item: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 9 seconds and the frames are 16:9; the sampled scenes follow the expected order, but the exact transition times are not shown.

must_haves.item: The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
must_haves.why: The first sampled frame displays the exact line.

must_haves.item: The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
must_haves.why: Both middle frames display the exact line.

must_haves.item: The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
must_haves.why: The final sampled frame displays the exact line.

must_haves.item: Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
must_haves.why: All sampled text is correct and readable, and no additional words are visible.

must_haves.item: The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.
must_haves.why: The frames show the requested palette and changing calendar/checkmark graphics, but the audio report identifies speech despite an extremely low peak level.
